## On-call rota → Mortar
Ops keeps the escalation ladder in a spreadsheet (columns: `rota` = after_hours | business_hours, `level` = 1, 2, 3…, `staff_id` = Mortar party id). Publish that tab as CSV (File → Share → Publish to web) and set `ONCALL_SHEET_CSV_URL`.

Every 15 minutes the ladder is rebuilt and synced. A rota with a missing level fails loudly instead of silently paging nobody.

Every request to Mortar is signed: the Code node builds the exact JSON string, the Crypto node signs that string (HMAC-SHA256, MORTAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET), and the HTTP node sends the same string as the raw body with `X-Mortar-Signature: sha256=<hex>`. Mortar rejects anything else with 401 and dedupes redeliveries by id.

Needs n8n env vars: `MORTAR_URL`, `MORTAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (and `N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false`).

meta.description: Ops edits the on-call ladder in a spreadsheet; Mortar's escalation ladder follows within 15 minutes.
